description: Names of the Cornell Center on the Death Penalty Worldwide lists (the database API behind dpw.lawschool.cornell.edu) that are not, letter for letter, the English name of a record of countries.json, with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code each one stands for. Kept by hand and checked against the UN Statistics Division M49 table: `iso2` is the code the Cornell list gives, `m49` the name of the M49 row with that alpha-2 code, and `id` the alpha-3 code of that row. The load also checks that the Cornell list still gives the same `iso2`. A Cornell name that is neither here nor a name of countries.json stops the load (scripts/load_death_penalty.py): it is never guessed. Separate from untc-names.json on purpose (docs/03-modelo-de-dados.md).
